title: A replace ref under refs/replace could change the blobs or the commit tree that status and snapshot read
resolution: GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 joins the built environment and contract section 7; tests replace a blob and the head commit.

title: An assume-unchanged or skip-worktree index flag hid a modified tracked file, so remove could delete unpublished work
resolution: Status first clears both flags through ls-files -v and update-index; contract section 6 says so; one test per flag.

title: Standard output of a process that carries the credential was returned without scrubbing
resolution: Standard output of a process with a credential is scrubbed byte-preserving; a test echoes the header on both streams.

title: Credential forms shorter than eight characters were not redacted, because the runner used the conformance heuristic
resolution: The runner redacts every non-empty form through its own credentialForms; a test with a three-character secret.

title: Node added NODE_V8_COVERAGE to the Git environment, and only the tests removed it
resolution: The runner names NODE_V8_COVERAGE as undefined so Node leaves it out; the tests no longer withhold it and a runner test sets it.

title: The checkout walk decoded names as UTF-8, so a directory whose name is not UTF-8 made the operation reject with ENOENT
resolution: The walk reads names and builds paths as bytes; tests cover a committed file and a gitfile under such a directory.

title: File system errors escaped prepare, inspect, snapshot, and remove as rejected promises
resolution: System errors become unavailable at the boundary, a malformed record internal, a crash still rejects; fault-injection tests.

title: A failed revision lookup read as a missing revision, so a prepare could fall back to the base branch
resolution: The lookup returns Result of string or undefined, with only exit code 1 as missing; a test fails rev-parse with exit 128.

title: The cat-file reader accepted another object type, a negative size, and objects that were not requested
resolution: The reader requires the requested blobs in order with a strict header, enough bytes, and nothing after; negative tests.

title: The status parser accepted malformed fields and output without the branch headers
resolution: Every field, path, and the branch.oid and branch.head headers are validated; negative tests per field.

title: The tree listing accepted a mode with trailing characters and an empty path
resolution: The mode must be six octal digits and the path non-empty; negative tests.
